lyra_gc10_exp_finale_distributed.title: Distributed Dissipation
lyra_gc10_exp_finale_distributed.interpretation: The player uses the broad verified network to dissipate the Echo across many prepared response points without requiring every optional capability.

lyra_gc10_exp_epilogue_distributed.title: After the Distributed Dissipation
lyra_gc10_exp_epilogue_distributed.interpretation: The Telluric Echo is dispersed through the prepared network. The victory came from broad verified coordination rather than one specialized route.

lyra_gc10_exp_finale_structural.title: Structural Redirection
lyra_gc10_exp_finale_structural.interpretation: The player redirects the Echo through the network's actual load-bearing paths, using Willow's slow-system cognition and Gronk's constraint sense to make the counterphase carry.

lyra_gc10_exp_epilogue_structural.title: After the Structural Redirection
lyra_gc10_exp_epilogue_structural.interpretation: The Echo is redirected through the network structures that could actually carry the counterphase. The ending foregrounds load paths, restraint, and durable craft judgment.

lyra_gc10_exp_finale_diagnostic.title: Diagnostic Disruption
lyra_gc10_exp_finale_diagnostic.interpretation: The player treats the Echo as an adversarial model, detects the contradiction in its next phase, and disrupts the repeating structure before it can reassert itself.

lyra_gc10_exp_epilogue_diagnostic.title: After the Diagnostic Disruption
lyra_gc10_exp_epilogue_diagnostic.interpretation: The Echo is disrupted by making its own predicted phase fail. The ending foregrounds evidence, contradiction, and calibrated opposition.

lyra_gc10_exp_finale_fortified.title: Fortified Containment
lyra_gc10_exp_finale_fortified.interpretation: The player uses verified counterphase procedures with legally available Watch logistics to contain the Echo long enough for the prepared network to hold.

lyra_gc10_exp_epilogue_fortified.title: After the Fortified Containment
lyra_gc10_exp_epilogue_fortified.interpretation: The Echo is contained through counterphase preparation backed by institutional logistics. The ending preserves the distinction between personal trust and public authority.
